books.title: Elements of Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging
books.authors: Tor D. Wager & Martin A. Lindquist (MIT Press, 2026)
books.blurb: A textbook on how fMRI works and the principles behind it, from MRI physics, physiology and experimental design through preprocessing, the general linear model, effect sizes and power, connectivity and network analysis, causal models, predictive models and biomarkers, and machine learning and deep learning.

books.title: Principles of fMRI
books.authors: Tor D. Wager & Martin A. Lindquist (Leanpub)
books.blurb: An e-book covering the key concepts involved in current fMRI acquisition and analysis, available online from Leanpub.

courses.title: Functional MRI 1
courses.blurb: Part 1 of an online Coursera course by Martin Lindquist and Tor Wager: free video lectures and self-quizzes covering image acquisition, experimental design and preprocessing.

courses.title: Functional MRI 2
courses.blurb: Part 2 of the Coursera course by Martin Lindquist and Tor Wager: the general linear model, multiple comparisons, connectivity, multivariate methods and reproducibility.

courses.title: fMRI Image Acquisition and Analysis with SPM and ICA
courses.blurb: A hands-on, immersive three-day fMRI analysis workshop with Vince Calhoun, Kent Kiehl and Tor Wager.

tools_intro: CANlab develops open-source tools for neuroimaging analysis, hosted at canlab.github.io with linked GitHub repositories and step-by-step walkthroughs.

tools.title: canlab.github.io
tools.blurb: The hub for CANlab analysis tools: linked repositories, walkthroughs and tutorials.

tools.title: Neuroimaging Pattern Masks
tools.blurb: Brain signature patterns (NPS, SIIPS, PINES and others), atlases of regions, and meta-analysis masks for neuroimaging data analysis.

tools.title: CANlab Core Tools
tools.blurb: Interactive, object-oriented data visualization and analysis, and multivariate prediction, in MATLAB.

tools.title: CANlab Help Examples
tools.blurb: Walkthroughs and help examples for CANlab Core, plus group analysis and prediction scripts.

tools.title: Mediation Toolbox
tools.blurb: Single- and multi-level mediation analysis, and mediation brain search (M3).

tools.title: MKDA neuroimaging meta-analysis
tools.blurb: Coordinate-based meta-analysis for neuroimaging using Multilevel Kernel Density Analysis and related statistical tools.

tools.title: Preprocessing Pipeline
tools.blurb: The CANlab SPM-based fMRI preprocessing pipeline.

chapters_intro: There is some overlap across chapters, but each covers some unique topics.
